verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents runbooks that attach to incidents and execute steps automatically, such as creating channels, assigning tasks or running diagnostics. Workflows are only shown auto-publishing to status pages. Investigations merely read runbooks as context for AI analysis, an adjacent capability that is not runbook step automation.

support.subject: As an SRE, runbooks attach to incidents and their steps can trigger automatically — creating channels, assigning tasks, running diagnostics
